Description: Susceptible humans become exposed through bites by infected mosquitoes.
Exposed humans become asymptomatic infectious at a rate dependent on age.
Exposed humans become symptomatic infectious at a rate dependent on age.
Asymptomatic infectious humans recover at an age-specific rate.
Asymptomatic infectious humans can be reinfected and become symptomatic infectious.
Symptomatic infectious humans recover at an age-specific rate.
Susceptible mosquitoes become infectious after biting infectious humans.

Name: B
Description: The constant influx rate of the human hosts.

Name: k(a)
Description: The rate at which exposed humans become infectious.

Name: μh
Description: The natural death rate of the human hosts.

Name: μv
Description: The natural death rate of the mosquitoes.

Name: γ1(a)
Description: The recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: γ2(a)
Description: The recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: βv(a)
Description: The transmission rate from infectious hosts to susceptible mosquitoes.

Name: βh(a)
Description: The transmission rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible hosts.

Name: ρ
Description: The probability of exposed hosts transferring to symptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: σ
Description: The factor characterizing the intensity of reinfection of asymptomatic infectious hosts.
